R1.name: Exact overlay and type inheritance
R1.condition: Whole raw token exactly matches a declared dictionary key; no entity substitution, splitting, joining or spelling normalization. ROOT_MATERIAL is a subtype of drug-stock/solid material; OIL_MATERIAL is a subtype of liquid.
R1.output: One fixed atomic value/type per exact whole. Known parent value survives G/I unchanged.
R1.scope: All nominated IT/ZL/RF positions; no outside verification claimed.

R2.name: Clinical topic
R2.condition: A PERSON nominal immediately precedes HEAT_PREDICATE at the start of a currently unbound directive frame.
R2.output: Introduce person P and generic clinical instruction episode A; P is the intended recipient/topic, not heat object.
R2.scope: Typed contiguous pattern; no line boundary supplies an unexpressed person.

R3.name: Prefix property
R3.condition: A property immediately precedes a compatible new material noun inside an unbound argument NP; parent-bound property assignments have priority and are never changed.
R3.output: Attach property to that noun only; cleansing at IT36G003 applies to ROOT at G004.
R3.scope: Immediate typed adjacency; no arbitrary attachment across unknowns.

R4.name: Postfix age property
R4.condition: A new material noun is immediately followed by AGE_PROPERTY.
R4.output: Attach age to the immediately preceding noun; oil-old yields OLD(O), not OLD(R).
R4.scope: Immediate typed adjacency, stops at unknown or another head.

R5.name: Root-in-medium heat frame
R5.condition: HEAT_PREDICATE followed by a solid argument NP and liquid argument NP terminated by MEDIUM_POSTPOSITION.
R5.output: Create generic instruction HEAT(solid, liquid medium); no extraction, separation, filtering, root removal, mixing or purification result.
R5.scope: Contiguous typed atoms, with optional R3/R4 NP modifiers; no unknown skipped.

R6.name: Typed backward reference
R6.condition: A MATERIAL_REFERENCE/STOCK_REFERENCE/LIQUID_REFERENCE occurs after resolved nominal mentions.
R6.output: Choose the most recent compatible resolved material/stock/liquid entity in written order. Unknown tokens never introduce a guessed referent. If no compatible referent is available or an unresolved boundary obstructs scope, return UNBOUND.
R6.scope: Current resolved discourse frame; type restrictions are semantic hypotheses, not spelling laws.

R7.name: Application argument and body-site ownership
R7.condition: APPLICATION_PREDICATE followed by a resolved MATERIAL_REFERENCE and BODY_SITE in a clinical-topic frame.
R7.output: Create generic APPLY(material, site) with topic person as recipient; site owned by that person is a paid default clinical grammar assumption. Material comes from the written reference, not a free placeholder.
R7.scope: Contiguous typed atoms; unresolved person/reference/site prevents complete application graph.

R8.name: Directive order
R8.condition: Two resolved action frames follow under the same clinical topic with no phase marker or unknown between them.
R8.output: Procedure order HEAT before APPLY; neither actual execution nor completion is asserted.
R8.scope: Generic instruction aspect; does not replace parent actual stream episodes/phases.

R9.name: Stock reintroduction
R9.condition: STOCK_REFERENCE immediately followed by old drug-stock nominal.
R9.output: Bind old D_stock nominal to the previously written compatible root reference through SAME_MATERIAL; root subtype is explicitly paid.
R9.scope: Contiguous exact atom pair; no unseen extraction relation.

R10.name: Written parcel-of carrier continuation
R10.condition: PARCEL_RELATION followed by resolved LIQUID_REFERENCE then an old instrumental-flow operator and its explicit liquid material nominal.
R10.output: Instrument material is a parcel of referenced liquid. Parcel identity is distinct; do not merge stream events or all liquid tokens. The parent history supplies M38 co-material and subsequent M39/M40/etc identity, unchanged.
R10.scope: Contiguous typed frame; if a reader separates/changes any atom the relation is unbound, not repaired.

R11.name: Parent commitment priority and unknown transparency
R11.condition: Any inherited positive role/entity/event/phase/attachment commitment is present, or raw token has no exact declared value.
R11.output: Copy inherited commitment literally; new graph adds only paid refinements. Every unmatched raw is UNKNOWN, interrupts new frame composition, and contributes an unresolved position rather than a guessed clause. RF graph is not inherited by reader analogy.
R11.scope: All82/86/81 positions. New local frames do not imply a full paragraph parse.

N1.condition: PREPARATION_MATERIAL followed immediately by old QOKAIIN of-liquid at the start of this new content clause.
N1.output: Introduce distinct P preparation and L liquid; GENITIVE(P,L), with P head and L dependent. PREPARATION_OF(P,L) is a paid genitive interpretation, not identity P=L.
N1.scope: New clause content only; never changes QOKAIIN or old parent attachments.

N2.condition: Resolved preparation NP, old SHEDAR, RESIDUE_MATERIAL, immediately postfix GRANULARITY_PROPERTY.
N2.output: DEPOSIT(E1,agent=P,theme=R); FINE(R). Subject is the preparation NP, object the residue NP. No basin or removal inferred.
N2.scope: Typed composition of this new clause; old SHEDAR stays transitive deposits.

N3.condition: SEQUENCE_OPERATOR after a closed deposit clause and before a RETENTION_PREDICATE frame.
N3.output: BEFORE(E1,E2); retains current resolved material discourse frame; the marker is a resolved operator, not UNKNOWN or a frame reset.
N3.scope: New content sequence only; no parent phase or event changed.

N4.condition: RETENTION_PREDICATE, MANNER_PROPERTY, old MATERIAL_REFERENCE, COVER_STATE_PROPERTY in that order.
N4.output: R6 resolves reference first; RETAIN(E2,theme=R), GENTLE(E2), COVERED_DURING(R,E2). The action consumes the written reference; postfix covered is a state qualification.
N4.scope: New typed retention frame. Does not alter R6 and does not reuse old R7 application grammar.

N5.condition: A closed retention frame explicitly consumed a resolved material, followed by paired PORTION_RELATION clauses.
N5.output: Make that explicitly referenced material R the shared base-carrier of the pair. Each portion introduces its own new material U or V and PART_OF(U,R)/PART_OF(V,R). No portion is coidentical with R; distinct discourse variables do not assert physically disjoint samples.
N5.scope: Paid new topic/parallelism grammar; fixed carrier belongs to the pair, not a most-recent-reference repair. No R6 invocation for DAIIN.

N6.condition: PORTION_RELATION, immediately postfix MOISTURE_PROPERTY, then STORAGE_PREDICATE.
N6.output: Introduce U portion of shared carrier R; DRY(U) restricts the portion; STORE(E3,theme=U). Preverbal NP supplies object in this new directive pattern.
N6.scope: New portion clause only; quantity/duration unspecified, no omitted patient.

N7.condition: A second PORTION_RELATION, immediately postfix MOISTURE_PROPERTY, EXPOSURE_PREDICATE, AIR_MATERIAL.
N7.output: Introduce V portion of the same N5 carrier R and H air; MOIST(V); EXPOSE(E4,theme=V,medium=H). The second material nominal is the medium because of the declared predicate frame.
N7.scope: New parallel portion clause only; no drying result or event chronology between E3/E4.

N8.condition: These closed new descriptive/directive frames occur in their own complete IT paragraph, with typed predicate valencies resolving clause cuts.
N8.output: E1 is a generic deposition description; E2/E3/E4 are generic recommendations. Retention and the portion pair share topic R. No actual execution, physiological success, exhaustive division, numerical amount, patient or authority is asserted. The written line break is layout only.
N8.scope: Aspect, clause cuts and topic continuation are paid new grammar, unconfirmed and owed globally wherever these constructions are asserted. Never extends or repairs f111r.
